mainEntity.name: What types of addiction does Bonvie Recovery treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonvie Recovery treats a wide range of substance use disorders, including addiction to alcohol, prescription medications, and illicit drugs. Their programs are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, with a focus on long-term recovery and relapse prevention.

mainEntity.name: What therapies are used at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonvie Recovery uses evidence-based therapies such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step facilitation. These are combined with holistic practices like yoga, meditation, Reiki, and art therapy to promote healing of the mind, body, and spirit.

mainEntity.name: How long are the treatment programs at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clients can choose from flexible program lengths of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days. Each program includes medical detox (if required), daily therapy sessions, holistic activities, and comprehensive aftercare planning.

mainEntity.name: Is family involved in the treatment process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Bonvie Recovery strongly encourages family involvement. The center provides support around topics like codependency, boundary setting, and healthy communication to help families heal alongside their loved ones.

mainEntity.name: What happens after I complete my program at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: After completing the residential program, clients receive personalized aftercare planning, access to virtual outpatient support, and participation in alumni groups. These services help maintain sobriety and support ongoing personal growth.

blocks.text: Bonvie Recovery, located near Kingston, Ontario, offers a comprehensive, individualized approach to addiction and mental health treatment. Rooted in their “Leading with Love” philosophy, Bonvie creates personalized care plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. Their evidence-based therapies include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step programming, delivered through both individual and group sessions. To support holistic healing, clients also benefit from practices such as yoga, meditation, Reiki, sound therapy, and art and music therapy—addressing the physical, emotional, and spiritual dimensions of recovery. Bonvie emphasizes family involvement, offering education and support around codependency, boundaries, and relationship rebuilding. Flexible residential program durations of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days are available, all set in a peaceful, lakeside environment ideal for healing. Medical detox, daily therapy, and wellness activities are part of each program. To promote long-term recovery, Bonvie also offers aftercare planning, virtual outpatient services, and alumni support groups. This well-rounded approach ensures clients are supported every step of the way—during and after their stay—making Bonvie Recovery a trusted destination for transformative care in Ontario.

Bonvie Recovery | Addiction Treatment Center in Ontario

Bonvie Recovery is a trusted addiction treatment center in Ontario dedicated to helping individuals reclaim their lives through evidence-based therapies, compassionate care, and long-term support. At Bonvie Recovery, we believe in healing the whole person—mind, body, and spirit—through a personalized and respectful approach to recovery.

Our facility offers a wide range of professional addiction treatment services, including medical detox, inpatient residential programs, outpatient support, relapse prevention, and aftercare planning. Whether you are struggling with alcohol, prescription medication, or drug dependency, Bonvie Recovery provides a safe and structured environment where transformation begins.

What sets Bonvie Recovery apart is our client-centered philosophy. We understand that every individual’s journey through addiction is unique. That’s why our treatment plans are tailored to meet the specific needs, goals, and challenges of each person who walks through our doors. Our team of licensed therapists, nurses, and addiction specialists work closely with each client to create a customized path to recovery.

At Bonvie Recovery, we integrate evidence-based therapies like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and trauma-informed care with holistic wellness practices, including mindfulness, yoga, and nutrition planning. This blended approach supports lasting recovery by addressing the root causes of addiction, not just the symptoms.

Our peaceful Ontario location provides a calming and private space ideal for healing, self-reflection, and personal growth. With 24/7 support and a strong focus on dignity and respect, Bonvie Recovery offers more than just addiction treatment—we offer a new beginning.

If you or a loved one is seeking compassionate, professional help, choose Bonvie Recovery. Our mission is to guide individuals toward a meaningful life, free from addiction. Start your recovery journey today in a space that empowers, heals, and uplifts.

Bonvie Recovery – Where recovery begins, and a new life takes shape.

Bonvie Recovery - Center Overview

Bonvie Recovery, located near Kingston, Ontario, offers a comprehensive, individualized approach to addiction and mental health treatment. Rooted in their “Leading with Love” philosophy, Bonvie creates personalized care plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. Their evidence-based therapies include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step programming, delivered through both individual and group sessions. To support holistic healing, clients also benefit from practices such as yoga, meditation, Reiki, sound therapy, and art and music therapy—addressing the physical, emotional, and spiritual dimensions of recovery. Bonvie emphasizes family involvement, offering education and support around codependency, boundaries, and relationship rebuilding. Flexible residential program durations of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days are available, all set in a peaceful, lakeside environment ideal for healing. Medical detox, daily therapy, and wellness activities are part of each program. To promote long-term recovery, Bonvie also offers aftercare planning, virtual outpatient services, and alumni support groups. This well-rounded approach ensures clients are supported every step of the way—during and after their stay—making Bonvie Recovery a trusted destination for transformative care in Ontario.

What types of addiction does Bonvie Recovery treat?

Bonvie Recovery - Center Overview

Bonvie Recovery, located near Kingston, Ontario, offers a comprehensive, individualized approach to addiction and mental health treatment. Rooted in their “Leading with Love” philosophy, Bonvie creates personalized care plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. Their evidence-based therapies include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step programming, delivered through both individual and group sessions. To support holistic healing, clients also benefit from practices such as yoga, meditation, Reiki, sound therapy, and art and music therapy—addressing the physical, emotional, and spiritual dimensions of recovery. Bonvie emphasizes family involvement, offering education and support around codependency, boundaries, and relationship rebuilding. Flexible residential program durations of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days are available, all set in a peaceful, lakeside environment ideal for healing. Medical detox, daily therapy, and wellness activities are part of each program. To promote long-term recovery, Bonvie also offers aftercare planning, virtual outpatient services, and alumni support groups. This well-rounded approach ensures clients are supported every step of the way—during and after their stay—making Bonvie Recovery a trusted destination for transformative care in Ontario.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bonvie Recovery

What types of addiction does Bonvie Recovery treat?

Bonvie Recovery treats a wide range of substance use disorders, including addiction to alcohol, prescription medications, and illicit drugs. Their programs are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, with a focus on long-term recovery and relapse prevention.

What therapies are used at Bonvie Recovery?

Bonvie Recovery uses evidence-based therapies such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step facilitation. These are combined with holistic practices like yoga, meditation, Reiki, and art therapy to promote healing of the mind, body, and spirit.

How long are the treatment programs at Bonvie Recovery?

Clients can choose from flexible program lengths of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days. Each program includes medical detox (if required), daily therapy sessions, holistic activities, and comprehensive aftercare planning.

Is family involved in the treatment process?

Yes, Bonvie Recovery strongly encourages family involvement. The center provides support around topics like codependency, boundary setting, and healthy communication to help families heal alongside their loved ones.

What happens after I complete my program at Bonvie Recovery?

After completing the residential program, clients receive personalized aftercare planning, access to virtual outpatient support, and participation in alumni groups. These services help maintain sobriety and support ongoing personal growth.
